name: Resume Rush
detailed_description:
Resume Rush is a fast-paced multiplayer negotiation game where players compete in the high-stakes world of corporate hiring. Take on the role of either a CEO with a limited budget trying to hire the best talent, or a job candidate aiming to secure the highest possible salary offer.

In timed rounds, CEOs review candidate resumes to determine their potential value, then make strategic offers before time runs out. Meanwhile, candidates must decide whether to accept current offers or hold out for better ones, all while negotiating with multiple companies. Every decision impacts your final score!

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dynamic Role-Based Gameplay - Experience both sides of the negotiation table as either a CEO or job candidate

  • Real-Time Strategy - Make quick decisions as the clock ticks down in each round

  • Multiplayer Action - Compete with 2-8 players locally or online

  • In-Game Text Chat - Negotiate directly with other players to secure better deals

  • Strategic Depth - Balance budget constraints, candidate values, and competitive offers

  • AI Players - Practice against computer opponents that adapt to your playing style

  • Comprehensive Scoring - Earn points based on your negotiation skills and strategic decisions

Will you spot the hidden talent and make the perfect hire as a CEO? Or will you masterfully negotiate your way to the highest salary as a candidate? Your negotiation skills will determine who comes out on top in this ultimate hiring showdown!

short_description: Master the job market in this fast-paced strategic multiplayer sim! Negotiate salaries, evaluate resumes, and experience both CEO and candidate perspectives. Customization settings, chat features, AI opponents, and real hiring insights. Perfect for interview prep and career skills.
